system.description:
• Effect: Apply a Metamagic option's base effect to a spell for free instead of paying with Spellburn — but the GM rolls on the Corruption Table afterward.
  • This is the risky, free route to Metamagic.
  • Uses per day: 1 (5th–8th level), 2 (9th–12th), 3 (13th–16th), 4 (17th–24th).
  • You may always pay with Spellburn instead to avoid the Corruption roll entirely

activities.name: Wild Surge
activities.text: Apply a Metamagic base effect for free; the GM then rolls on the Corruption Table.
